teachingModel: Full-resolution unconditional MNIST-zero U-Nets, channels 32/64/64, one layer per block, no attention
imageTransform: Native 32×32 state, no resizing or padding. No clipping before feature extraction.
featureTransform: Frozen continued U-Net; mid-block features averaged over all ten labels at probe timestep 500; subtract original mean and multiply by original PC1/PC2 axes.
